description: Get the voice compliance report for one phone number: takes `phoneNumber` (required, E.164, e.g. +442012345678, from listComplianceReports) and optional `sector`. Built from the latest run of each compliance catalogue test against that number, with a summary (ran, passed, failed of the tests that apply) and the tests grouped by regulation, each with its verdict, the judge's reasoning and evidence, and the run it came from (runId). Use when: the user asks whether a number is compliant or which compliance checks it fails. For a single run's detail use getRunResults with the run id. Read-only. Needs testing:read. Only your workspace's runs are read.

sector.description: Sector filter (e.g. `financial-services`). Omit to include all sectors.

name: getComplianceReportByPhone

outputSchema.description:
Aggregated multi-regime "emergent view" for one phone number. Returned by
`GET /testing/compliance-reports/{phoneNumber}`. Built by `buildComplianceReport()`
in `api/packages/core/compliance/aggregator.ts` — see source for the full shape;
additional keys may be added over time.
